violation_type.title: Activities for Toddlers - Opportunities for Moderate to Vigorous Active Play (26 TAC §746.2507(5))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for Toddlers - Opportunities for Moderate to Vigorous Active Play
violation_type.typical_finding: A toddler was observed confined to a restrictive device for over 30 minutes and not provided an opportunity for moderate to vigorous active play that encourages movement. This was corrected during the inspection when the child was observed being removed from the restrictive device.

finding_variants.text: A toddler was observed confined to a restrictive device for over 30 minutes and not provided an opportunity for moderate to vigorous active play that encourages movement. This was corrected during the inspection when the child was observed being removed from the restrictive device.

Staff were questioned on active play routine with bad weather days, all staff stated they get active play by having the children play in their centers. Children could not go outside during inspection due to poor weather conditions.

Investigation documentation provided information that shows a child was strapped into a chair during most of his day in care. This restriction limited his opportunity to engage in activities that encouraged movement.   This has been corrected due to the operation removing the tables and booster seats that have straps.
